The ILPA Reporting Template (the “Reporting Template”) was first developed in 2016 to promote more uniform reporting practices in the PE industry related to fees, expenses and carried interest [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.1]. To deliver the next evolution of ILPA quarterly reporting standards, this updated Reporting Template was developed throughout 2024 and released in January 2025 as one critical deliverable of ILPA’s Quarterly Reporting Standards Initiative (QRSI) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.1].

ILPA Reporting Template (v. 2.0) – This packet was last updated on January 22, 2025 Below is a summary of all changes to the Template since its original release in January 2025: No revisions as of the last updated date [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.5]. Other Fee Offsets: 2016 ILPA Reporting Template Value  Introduced to allow GPs to report offsets previously classified in a more rolled-up fashion in the 2016 ILPA Reporting Template dating back to the inception of the private fund, without requiring a reclassification of the offsets [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Contributions – Cash & Non-Cash  Capital contributions to the private fund from investors as captured on the Statement of Changes in Partners' Capital / Individual partner's Capital Account Statements [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Distributions – Cash and Non-Cash  Capital distributions from the private fund to investors as captured on the Statement of Changes in Partners' Capital / Individual partner's Capital Account Statements [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].
